common.quickStartTitle: Quick Start: Paste into your AI chat
common.quickStartPrompt: Configure my development agent with Artemisa using the configuration from this endpoint: {url}

landing.heroDescription: Configure development agents compatible with 6+ platforms in minutes. An explainable decision tree generates reproducible files ready to apply, no black box.
landing.ctaDescription: Answer 32 guided questions and get a bundle ready for Cursor, Devin, CodeRabbit, Kiro and more.

valueProps.title: Deterministic decision tree
valueProps.description: 32 guided steps that adapt the configuration to your context: development, production, or both. Reduce hours of tuning to minutes without letting an LLM decide the architecture for you.

valueProps.title: Evidence-based recommendations
valueProps.description: Every suggestion includes rationale, trade-offs and compared alternatives. Configure with visible criteria and reduce blind decisions.

valueProps.title: Compatible with 6+ platforms
valueProps.description: One bundle adapts to Cursor, Devin, CodeRabbit, Kilo Code, Kiro and other tools. Apply your agent where you already work, without rewriting configurations.

techStack.title: Technology we use
techStack.subtitle: Artemisa is open source. This is the exact stack it is built with.

legal.title: License and usage
legal.p1After: . It is a weak copyleft license: you can use, modify and distribute the software, even combined with proprietary code, but any modified file from this project must remain under MPL-2.0 and keep the original copyright and contributor notice.
legal.p2: The creator does not execute code, make network calls or use credentials during configuration generation: it is a pure, deterministic and auditable compilation. Artemisa only generates configuration files; applying and running the agent is always the user's responsibility.
legal.p3Before: Full source code, changelog, authors and issue reporting are available at

completion.title: Bundle generated
completion.artifactCount: {count} artifacts ready. Artemisa does not write anything to your project: review, download, and copy the files yourself.

step1.text: in the 'Files' tab. Read the blueprint, steering and security policy before copying anything.

step2.text: and copy it to your project root, respecting the relative path of each file.

step3.text: and confirm the SHA-256 hashes in 'Manifest and hashes' to verify nothing changed.
